skill.summary: Warner Bros. Discovery is a century-old media giant owning HBO, DC Comics, and Max streaming, specializing in film, TV, and digital content worldwide.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the Warner Bros. Discovery skill.

- Includes business model overview, unique strengths, and essential company data.
